scores.notes: Alice in both is a girl of about seven to ten with long light-brown hair, fair skin and a round face, in a yellow dress with white pinafore and blue-striped stockings.
Alice in both is a fair-skinned girl with long wavy light-brown hair and the same round face, in a yellow puff-sleeved dress, white pinafore and blue-striped stockings.

Both show a striped mown lawn enclosed by tall clipped hedges with giant mushrooms and woodland behind, with hedgehogs, a flamingo and hoops; hoops are striped arches left and bent cards right, and the trees are more autumnal right, but the layout is compatible.

Left Alice has long straight golden-blonde hair to mid-back with a headband; right Alice has darker brown, wavy, roughly shoulder-length hair with no headband. Age, face and dress agree, but hair colour, texture and length conflict beyond what the dim hall light explains.

Alice is a young girl with wavy brown hair, round cheeks and fair skin in both; hair reads darker in the lamplit hall and lighter with a headband in the sunlit garden, but texture, age and face agree.
The Cat is a grey-brown striped tabby with the same very wide toothy grin, pink nose and pointed ears in both; full body on a branch left, floating head with open yellow eyes right.

Both have a tea table under a big oak with a house behind, but the left table is draped in a long white cloth before a distant tan stone gabled house, while the right is a bare plank table with no cloth beside a close red-brick half-timbered cottage. Table covering and house architecture conflict.

Alice is a fair young girl with long light hair past her shoulders, round face and the same yellow dress and pinafore in both; hair reads light brown in the dim forest and more golden in sunlight, with no conflict in length, age or face.

Alice (holding the flamingo on the left; standing in the courtroom aisle on the right) is the same young girl with long light-brown/dark-blonde hair, fair skin and round face in both, in the same yellow dress, white pinafore and blue-striped stockings.

Alice (seated at the table end on the left; small standing figure in profile before the mushroom on the right) has the same long straight light-brown hair, fair skin, child's build and age in both, with the yellow dress, white pinafore and striped stockings; the right face is small and in profile but nothing conflicts.

Alice (small profile figure by the mushroom on the left; standing in the court aisle on the right) has the same long straight light-brown/dark-blonde hair, fair skin and young child's build in both, with yellow dress, white pinafore and striped stockings; the left face is small and in profile but nothing conflicts.

Both show a long white-clothed tea table on a lawn under one big broad-trunked tree with an old English gabled, timber-framed house to the left behind, in soft daylight; the house is farther off and browner on the left and close with brick and bay windows on the right, but style and arrangement are compatible with a shifted viewpoint.

Both show a white-clothed tea table on a lawn beneath one big broad-trunked tree with a brick and half-timbered, leaded-window English house to the left behind, in soft daylight; the house sits closer and larger on the left and set back on the right, but its Tudor style and the arrangement are compatible.

Left Alice is clear (wavy light-brown hair, round child's face). On the right she is a small figure turned away toward the bench, showing mostly the back of her head and only a sliver of profile, so the face cannot be compared; long light-brown hair, child's build and the yellow dress/pinafore are consistent but not enough to judge identity.

Alice (holding up the bottle on the left; standing beside the mushroom on the right) is the same young girl with wavy light-brown shoulder-length hair, round fair face, similar age and small build in both, in the yellow dress, white pinafore and blue-striped stockings.

Alice (seated in the armchair on the left; running with the flamingo on the right) is the same young girl with long wavy light-brown hair, fair rosy round face, similar age and build in both, in yellow dress, white pinafore and striped stockings; hair reads slightly more golden left and more chestnut right, a lighting-level difference only.

Alice (standing in the court on the left; seated in the armchair on the right) is the same young girl with long straight light-brown hair, fair round face, similar age and build in both, in yellow dress, white pinafore and striped stockings.

Both have a long tea table under a big tree with a house behind on the left, but the left house is pale stone/stucco with plain windows and the table has a white cloth, while the right house is red brick and timber with leaded lattice windows and a tiled porch and the table is bare wood.

Alice before the mushroom (left, small, in profile) and holding the bottle (right): both a young girl with long straight light-brown hair, fair skin and slight build, same yellow dress, white pinafore, blue sash and striped stockings.

Both show a long cloth-covered tea table on a lawn beneath a huge spreading tree with the trunk right of centre and a pale stone two-storey house behind on the left, same chairs and china; the left house has more gables but nothing clearly conflicts.

Alice before the mushroom (left, small, profile) and holding the flamingo (right): both a young girl with long light-brown hair held by a band, fair skin and slight build, same yellow dress, white pinafore, blue sash and striped stockings.

Alice has the same long wavy light-brown hair, young age and slight build in both, in the yellow dress, white pinafore and striped stockings; at right she is smaller and turned mostly away but nothing conflicts.

Both show a long cloth-covered tea table on a lawn in front of a huge oak trunk with a gabled, chimneyed house behind to the left; the house is browner timber at left and half-timbered brick at right but the layout matches.
Both show a walled garden lawn with rounded topiary, a stone wall, tall trees, playing-card hoops in the mid-distance and mushrooms at the right edge under a soft daytime sky.

Both show a sunlit rough lawn enclosed by tall clipped hedges with big trees, giant mushrooms beyond the hedge at the right and playing-card hoops; the left also shows a stone wall and topiary balls, a compatible other angle.

Right Alice is clear (long wavy light-brown hair, blue band, smiling face) but on the left she is small and seen from behind with her face turned away; only long light-brown hair and the yellow dress can be compared.

The left Cat (floating head) is a warm brown tabby with yellow-amber eyes; the right Cat (on the branch) is a silver-grey tabby with green eyes, while Alice's hair stays warm in that image so the grey is not just lighting.

Both show a grassy lawn enclosed by tall clipped hedges with oversized mushrooms along the edge and warm autumn-toned trees behind in soft daylight; left uses card-soldier arches and a ridged lawn where the right has wire hoops, a minor difference.

Alice (standing before the bench on the left, facing the Caterpillar on the right) has the same long light-brown hair, fair skin, small child's build and age; she is small and partly turned away on the left so the face is only partly comparable.

Alice is a young girl with long light-brown hair, fair skin, yellow dress with white apron and blue sash, striped stockings in both; hair is wavier with a headband on the left, straighter on the right, but colour, length, age and face agree.

Alice (left standing before the court; right holding the bottle) is the same young girl with long straight light-brown hair, fair skin and round face, in the same yellow dress, white apron, blue sash and striped stockings.

Both show a daylit croquet lawn enclosed by rounded clipped hedges with tall trees and clusters of giant mushrooms at the edge, hoops, hedgehogs and flamingos on the grass; hoop style and hedge tint differ slightly but the place is compatible.

Both show a sunny garden croquet lawn with playing-card arches, hedgehogs, tall trees and giant mushrooms at the right edge; left boundary is a masonry wall with topiary and the right a tall hedge, which a different viewpoint of one garden could explain.

Alice (left cradling the flamingo; right holding the bottle) is the same young girl with long light-brown hair, fair skin and round face, in the same yellow dress, white apron, blue sash and striped stockings; hair is a little wavier on the left.
